SELECT 'F120' AS REGISTRO, PRO.CODPROD AS CODPROD, BEM.CODBEM AS CODBEM, PRO.DESCRPROD AS DESCRPROD, BEM.NUMNOTA AS NUMNOTA, BEM.DTINICIODEP AS DTINICIODEP, PRO.IDENTIMOB AS IDENTIMOB, CAST(SNK_GET_ORIGEM_PRODUTO(PRO.CODPROD, 2) AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS ORIGPROD, (CASE WHEN NVL(BEM.UTILIMOB, 0) = 0 THEN PRO.UTILIMOB ELSE BEM.UTILIMOB END) AS UTILIMOB, PRO.GRUPOPIS AS GRUPOPIS, PRO.GRUPOCOFINS AS GRUPOCOFINS, PRO.NATBCPISCOFINS AS NATBCPISCOFINS, MOV.CODEMP AS CODEMP, BEM.CSTCOFINS AS CSTCOFINS, BEM.CSTPIS AS CSTPIS, BEM.VLREXCBASECRED AS VLREXCBASECRED, BEM.ALIQPIS AS ALIQPIS, BEM.ALIQCOFINS AS ALIQCOFINS, CAST(SNK_GET_CONTACONTABIL_IMOB_EFD('C', 'F120', MOV.CODEMP, MOV.CODPROD, MOV.NUMLOTE, MOV.NUMLANC, MOV.REFERENCIA) AS VARCHAR2(60)) AS CTACTB, CAST(SNK_GET_CENTROCUSTO_IMOB_EFD('C', 'F120', MOV.CODEMP, MOV.CODPROD, MOV.NUMLOTE, MOV.NUMLANC, MOV.REFERENCIA) AS FLOAT) AS CODCENCUS, SUM(MOV.VLRDEP) AS VLRDEP, SUM(CASE WHEN ((PRO.TEMCREDPISCOFINSDEPR = 'S') OR (BEM.TEMCREDPISCOFINSDEPR = 'S')) THEN MOV.VLRDEP ELSE 0 END) AS BASECRED
FROM TCIMOV MOV INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON MOV.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD INNER JOIN TCIBEM BEM ON (MOV.CODBEM = BEM.CODBEM AND MOV.CODPROD = BEM.CODPROD)
WHERE MOV.REFERENCIA BETWEEN :P_PERIODO.INI AND :P_PERIODO.FIN AND (MOV.CODEMP = 1 OR MOV.CODEMP IS NULL) AND MOV.TIPMOV = 'A' AND NVL(BEM.TEMCREDPISCOFINSDEPR,'N') = 'S'
GROUP BY PRO.CODPROD, BEM.CODBEM, PRO.DESCRPROD, BEM.NUMNOTA, BEM.DTINICIODEP, PRO.IDENTIMOB, CAST(SNK_GET_ORIGEM_PRODUTO(PRO.CODPROD, 2) AS VARCHAR2(10)), (CASE WHEN NVL(BEM.UTILIMOB, 0) = 0 THEN PRO.UTILIMOB ELSE BEM.UTILIMOB END), PRO.GRUPOPIS, PRO.GRUPOCOFINS, PRO.NATBCPISCOFINS, MOV.CODEMP, BEM.CSTCOFINS, BEM.CSTPIS, BEM.VLREXCBASECRED, BEM.ALIQPIS, BEM.ALIQCOFINS, CAST(SNK_GET_CONTACONTABIL_IMOB_EFD('C', 'F120', MOV.CODEMP, MOV.CODPROD, MOV.NUMLOTE, MOV.NUMLANC, MOV.REFERENCIA) AS VARCHAR2(60)), CAST(SNK_GET_CENTROCUSTO_IMOB_EFD('C', 'F120', MOV.CODEMP, MOV.CODPROD, MOV.NUMLOTE, MOV.NUMLANC, MOV.REFERENCIA) AS FLOAT)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'F130' AS REGISTRO, BM.CODPROD AS CODPROD, BM.CODBEM AS CODBEM, BM.DESCRPROD AS DESCRPROD, BM.NUMNOTA AS NUMNOTA, BM.DTINICIODEP AS DTINICIODEP, BM.IDENTIMOB AS IDENTIMOB, CAST(BM.ORIGPROD AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS ORIGPROD, BM.UTILIMOB AS UTILIMOB, BM.GRUPOPIS AS GRUPOPIS, BM.GRUPOCOFINS AS GRUPOCOFINS, BM.NATBCPISCOFINS AS NATBCPISCOFINS, BM.CODEMP AS CODEMP, BM.CSTCOFINS AS CSTCOFINS, BM.CSTPIS AS CSTPIS, BM.VLREXCBASECRED AS VLREXCBASECRED, BM.ALIQPIS AS ALIQPIS, BM.ALIQCOFINS AS ALIQCOFINS, '0' AS CTACTB, 0 AS CODCENCUS, 0 AS VLRDEP, SUM(BM.VL_BC_PISCOFINS) AS BASECRED FROM (SELECT BEM.IDENTIMOB, BEM.NUMNOTA, BEM.CODBEM, BEM.CODEMP, BEM.CODPROD, BEM.NATBCPISCOFINS, BEM.DESCRPROD, BEM.ORIGPROD, BEM.GRUPOPIS, BEM.GRUPOCOFINS, BEM.DTINICIODEP, BEM.UTILIMOB, BEM.MES_OPER_AQUIS, BEM.MES_OPER_AQUIS_INSERT, BEM.IND_NR_PARC, BEM.CSTPIS, BEM.ALIQPIS, BEM.CSTCOFINS, BEM.ALIQCOFINS, BEM.VLRAQUISICAO, BEM.VL_BC_PISCOFINS, BEM.VLREXCBASECRED FROM (SELECT BEM.CODEMP, BEM.NUMNOTA, BEM.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.GRUPOPIS, PRO.GRUPOCOFINS, BEM.CODBEM, PRO.IDENTIMOB, CASE WHEN SNK_GET_ORIGEM_PRODUTO(PRO.CODPROD, 1) IN ('0','3','4','5','8') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS ORIGPROD, CASE WHEN BEM.UTILIMOB IS NOT NULL THEN BEM.UTILIMOB ELSE PRO.UTILIMOB END AS UTILIMOB, SNK_FORMAT_DATE(BEM.DTCOMPRA, 'MMYYYY') AS MES_OPER_AQUIS, BEM.DTCOMPRA AS MES_OPER_AQUIS_INSERT, CASE WHEN BEM.PISCOFMP540 = 'S' THEN 9 WHEN BEM.NPARCPISCOF = 1 THEN 1 WHEN BEM.NPARCPISCOF = 12 THEN 2 WHEN BEM.NPARCPISCOF = 24 THEN 3 WHEN BEM.NPARCPISCOF = 48 THEN 4 WHEN BEM.NPARCPISCOF = 6 THEN 5 ELSE 9 END AS IND_NR_PARC, BEM.CSTPIS, BEM.DTINICIODEP, BEM.ALIQPIS, PRO.NATBCPISCOFINS, BEM.CSTCOFINS, BEM.ALIQCOFINS, BEM.VLRAQUISICAO, ROUND(BEM.VLRAQUISICAO / SNK_GETNPARCPISCOF(BEM.NPARCPISCOF, BEM.PISCOFMP540, BEM.DTCOMPRA), 2) AS VL_BC_PISCOFINS, BEM.VLREXCBASECRED FROM TCIBEM BEM LEFT JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON BEM.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD WHERE BEM.TEMCREDPISCOFINSDEPR <> 'S' AND (SNK_GETDTBAIXABEM(BEM.CODPROD, BEM.CODBEM,:P_PERIODO.INI) > :P_PERIODO.INI OR SNK_GETDTBAIXABEM(BEM.CODPROD, BEM.CODBEM, :P_PERIODO.INI) IS NULL) AND (SNK_TRUNC_DATE(BEM.DTCOMPRA, 'MM') <= :P_PERIODO.INI ) AND SNK_GETNPARCPISCOF(BEM.NPARCPISCOF, BEM.PISCOFMP540, BEM.DTCOMPRA) > 0 AND :P_PERIODO.INI <= SNK_DATE_ADD(SNK_TRUNC_DATE(BEM.DTCOMPRA, 'MM'), 'MM', SNK_GETNPARCPISCOF(BEM.NPARCPISCOF, BEM.PISCOFMP540, BEM.DTCOMPRA) + SNK_GETMESESSEMPIS(BEM.CODPROD, BEM.CODBEM,:P_PERIODO.INI) - 1) AND (BEM.CODEMP = 1) AND NVL(BEM.VLRAQUISICAO,0) > 0 ) BEM LEFT JOIN TCIMOV MOV ON MOV.CODPROD = BEM.CODPROD AND MOV.CODBEM = BEM.CODBEM AND MOV.REFERENCIA = :P_PERIODO.INI AND MOV.TIPMOV IN ('A','C') WHERE (MOV.SEQUENCIA IS NULL OR MOV.SEQUENCIA = (SELECT MAX(M2.SEQUENCIA) FROM TCIMOV M2 WHERE M2.CODPROD = MOV.CODPROD AND M2.CODBEM = MOV.CODBEM AND M2.REFERENCIA = :P_PERIODO.INI AND M2.TIPMOV IN ('A','C'))) ) BM GROUP BY BM.IDENTIMOB, BM.NUMNOTA, BM.GRUPOPIS, BM.GRUPOCOFINS, BM.CODBEM, BM.CODEMP, BM.CODPROD, BM.NATBCPISCOFINS, BM.DESCRPROD, BM.ORIGPROD, BM.UTILIMOB, BM.DTINICIODEP, BM.MES_OPER_AQUIS, BM.MES_OPER_AQUIS_INSERT, BM.IND_NR_PARC, BM.CSTPIS, BM.VLREXCBASECRED, BM.ALIQPIS, BM.CSTCOFINS, BM.ALIQCOFINS
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4
